properties.lithology: Fine-grained rhythmic phyllosilicate-bearing mudstone and clay-siltstone lamina
properties.interpretation: Low-energy standing lacustrine lake deposition at the western delta foreset scarp
properties.trafficability: Moderate hazard — steep 15°–25° scarp slopes with boulder talus

properties.lithology: Coarse- to medium-grained cross-bedded sandstones and conglomerate channel ridges
properties.interpretation: Subaerial to shallow-water distributary fluvial channels and delta plain bedforms
properties.trafficability: High trafficability — planar sandstone benches with minor ripple bedforms

properties.lithology: Coarse crystalline olivine-rich basaltic cumulate with polygonal cooling fractures
properties.interpretation: Igneous lava lake pond or shallow differentiated sill, aqueously altered by early groundwater
properties.trafficability: Extreme trafficability hazard — loose aeolian sand dunes and razor-sharp fractured bedrock

properties.unit_name: Belva Crater Ejecta and Rim Breccia
properties.lithology: Heterogeneous polymict impact breccia and excavated sub-delta blocks
properties.interpretation: Recent impact event punching through delta strata into deeper crater floor units
properties.trafficability: Severe hazard — meter-scale boulder fields and steep crater rim escarpments

properties.lithology: Stromatolitic or laminated magnesium-carbonate and hydrated silica benches
properties.interpretation: Nearshore lacustrine precipitation bench or spring deposit fringing inner crater wall
properties.trafficability: Moderate trafficability — terraced benches with localized steep slopes

properties.lithology: Ancient brecciated crustal rocks with localized hydrothermal clay veins
properties.interpretation: Pre-impact Isidis Basin and Jezero Crater impact rim bedrock
properties.trafficability: Impassable for rovers — relief exceeds 500 meters with vertical cliffs
